# Source fixtures

- overnight-layout.json: positioned text/word excerpt from the official CLAA Vancouver 2027 PDF, October 2, 2026 edition. Tests separate ASUKA2 arrival-only/departure-only rows.
- sydney-2026-text.txt: PyMuPDF text from the 90-entry official Port of Sydney 2026 PDF linked by its live DOWNLOAD anchor, April 29 edition. Retrieved November 25, 2026.
- louisbourg-2026-text.txt: PyMuPDF text from the official six-entry Louisbourg 2026 PDF linked by Port of Sydney. No publication date is printed.
- maritime-links.html: the factual href/aria-label pairs from the reviewed Port of Sydney index. The collector discovers these links again on each refresh.
- halifax-table-excerpt.html: representative HTML using three factual rows from indexed official Halifax 2026 text. This is explicitly not a live complete source capture and is used only to test missing-time preservation and conflicting-year rejection.

Original publications are linked in the repository README. PDF binaries are not mirrored.
